# Dialog

Modal for a focused task (short form, confirmation) that must finish before the page continues.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Dialog` · Feedback

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Dialog open>…</AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Dialog>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Dialog" open="{{yes}}">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Accessible modal: --z-modal scrim, focus trap, Escape, focus return, scroll lock, enter animation.

## Props (DialogProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open` * | `boolean` | Render when true; unmounts when false. |
| `onClose` | `() => void` | Escape, scrim click and the close button call this. |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` | Heading (h2, aria-labelledby). |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` | One-line context under the title (aria-describedby). |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | Body: form fields, content. |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` | Buttons, end-aligned. Secondary first, then the one primary. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | Panel width 420 / 560 / 720. @default "md" |
| `tone` | `'default' \| 'danger'` | danger adds the red glyph tile for destructive confirms. @default "default" |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` | Allow Escape / scrim / × to close. Set false while a submit is in flight. @default true |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | @default "Close" |
| `initialFocusRef` | `React.RefObject<HTMLElement>` | Element to focus on open (defaults to the first field or button). |

_Also accepts: Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'title'>._
